title: Nourishing Smoky French Chicken Terrine
description: A savory and energizing French dish from Provence, featuring caramelized sugar sauce and a smoky flavor, all in a low-calorie friendly terrine form. This dish is perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and coat evenly with the spice mixture.
In a large skillet, caramelize the sugar over medium heat until it turns a deep brown color.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine with the caramelized sugar.
Add the coated chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Transfer the chicken to a terrine dish and top with the caramelized sugar sauce.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg whites and chopped fresh thyme.
Pour the egg white mixture over the chicken in the terrine dish.
Bake the terrine in the preheated oven for 35 minutes or until the egg whites are set.
